decisions.reason: The app builds directly on the firm's existing dental patient-data software, so its absorptive capacity to interpret feedback and improve it is high.

Running a continuing education institute requires capabilities in accreditation and training delivery that are distant from the firm's software and consultancy knowledge, limiting its ability to learn and improve.
The remote screen sharing tool is close to the firm's core IT/software capabilities, allowing it to assimilate user feedback and refine the product.
The analytics dashboard leverages the firm's existing dental practice data and software expertise, so it can effectively interpret performance results and enhance the product.
The complete bundle is a natural extension of the firm's established dental software suite, strongly aligned with its accumulated knowledge.
A job and practice listing portal requires network-building and recruitment marketplace expertise that lies outside the firm's core software/consultancy absorptive capacity.
